contract: {"interface":{"mode":"functional","class_name":null,"function_name":"matrixfy","signature":"name: str -> list[list[str]]"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"isinstance(name, str)","description":"The input must be a string."},{"id":"P2","expression":"len(name) >= 1","description":"The length of the name must be at least one letter."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"len(stdout) == len(stdout[0]) and all(len(row) == len(stdout) for row in stdout)","description":"The output must be a perfect square matrix."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"stdout == [['.'] * len(stdout) for _ in range(len(stdout))] if len(name) == 0 else [[name[i] if i < len(name) else '.' for i in range(len(stdout))] for _ in range(len(stdout))],"description":"The output matrix must contain the characters of the name, padded with periods if necessary."}],"invariants":[]}
